# ADR-3255: AWS security_groups: Database SG attached to public interface for db 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Public interfaces plus DB ports equal exposure.

## Decision

Databases MUST NOT use a database SG attached to public interface for db 7 (AWS-security_groups-7).

## Consequences

DB SGs only accept app-tier SGs.
